DeployBot: Deployment v5.3.1 -> canary traffic 10% (us-west/eu1). Verifier scan started: verifier-4220001111.
Ada: Noted. I'll watch dashboards and kick off synthetic batch-1 against the new variant. @Sam can you grab p95 for /embed route?
Sam: Running quick query now. p95 /embed (us-west) = 86ms vs baseline 82ms. No 5xx in logs so far.
OpsBot: synthetic-run batch-1 completed. 3 failures observed on eu1-cold path (timeouts). request ids: r123, r124, r125.
Mike: Do we know if those came from model variant fallback or routing misconfig?
Jen: Edge logs show fallbacks to small-quant variant for r124 & r125. Also see long KV cache misses around those timestamps.
Lina: Suggest we hold the global rollout at 10% and pin eu1 to v5.3.0 while we investigate. Also consider increasing cold-host timeout for synthetic checks to 4s temporarily. :thinking_face:
Ada: Agree with hold + pin. @Sam can you execute a pin for eu1 via rollout API? Example: `curl -X POST /rollouts/pin -d '{"region":"eu1","version":"v5.3.0"}'`
Sam: Pinned eu1 -> v5.3.0 (rollout id rpin-789). Confirmed traffic back to stable variant. Re-ran synthetic batch-2 against eu1 cold hosts: 0 failures, p95 = 88ms.
OpsBot: verifier-scan summary: overall PASS with caveat: eu1 required pin due to KV warmup causing transient timeouts. Recommendation: continue staged rollout to 30% after 30m observation. Created ticket ENG-4231 for warmup fix.
Mike: Drafting quick release note: "v5.3.1: performance improvements + routing changes. Temporary pin in eu1 to v5.3.0 due to KV warmup-induced timeouts; fix in progress."
Jen: Opening PR for KV warmup tweak (warming jitter + prefill on new hosts). ETA ~2h. Will add regression tests to synthetic harness.
Lina: Leaving rollout at 10% and monitoring logs/alerts. Re-run full verifier in 30 minutes and report back. :thumbsup:
